capabilities: Open and edit .mdx files as native Markdown notes
Compile static MDX expressions from frontmatter, plugin scope, and static exports in reading view
Toggle vault-level compiled preview via a status icon or command
Fail open to plain rendering for unsupported or invalid MDX
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; beta installation via BRAT is mentioned alongside standard install steps.
problem: Obsidian does not recognize .mdx files as notes or preview their JSX-based content, and executing MDX code would be unsafe.

relations.evidence: Beta installations can use BRAT with TrueNine/croessweave-obsidian-plugin.

summary: Opens prompt-focused .mdx files as native Markdown notes and renders a static, safe compiled preview in reading view.
